controls.name: ignore-recorded-requirements
controls.description: a requirement is checked without the requirements already recorded on the module (#L1096-L1104 removed)

controls.name: ignore-installed-requirements
controls.description: installed modules' requirements are not applied (#L1106-L1121 removed)

controls.name: no-downgrade-floor
controls.description: the '>=installed' bound is not added (#L1148-L1154 removed)

controls.name: keep-installed-unchecked
controls.description: the installed version is kept without checking it against the constraints

controls.name: chosen-module-not-queued
controls.description: a chosen module is not added to the next depth, so its own requirements are never read

controls.name: record-under-wrong-version
controls.description: the requirement is recorded under the wrong parent version

controls.name: done-with-queue-left
controls.description: the resolver stops although the next depth still has modules

controls.name: no-premise-pu
controls.description: drop premise PU (a manifest names a module once)

controls.name: no-premise-pr
controls.description: drop premise PR (no requirement names the root)

controls.name: l1-newest-only-solutions
controls.description: vacuity: an L1 that accepts only newest versions makes nc-dep-11 unsolvable; the DEC-DEP-1 witness must break

controls.name: l1-permit-unconstrained
controls.description: vacuity: L1 without 'a PermitDowngrade resolution can be loaded' must lose the F-DEP-1 witness

controls.name: l1-lockfile-unordered
controls.description: vacuity: L1 without 'needed modules come first' must lose the F-DEP-2 witness

controls.name: l1-case-sensitive
controls.description: vacuity: L1 that allows a case-sensitive lookup must lose the F-DEP-3 witness

controls.name: spurious-cycle
controls.description: finding 1 analogue: the cycle test reports a cycle for every module (a resolution fails with no cycle)

controls.name: exact-requirement-fails
controls.description: finding 1 analogue: an exact requirement fails resolution although a version meets it

controls.name: finished-reported-failed
controls.description: finding 1 analogue: a resolution whose queue is empty ends Failed instead of Done
